en.title: Buying an Elves frameset: distributors, custom paint and realistic lead times
en.description: Order an Elves frameset through a verified seller, approve the paint and cockpit specification, and understand production, shipping and return terms.
en.intro: The color configurator is the fun part. Before falling in love with a finish, work out who is taking the order, which generation you are buying and when the frame will actually be ready to leave the factory.

sections.heading: Choose the seller before configuring the paint
paragraphs: Elves’ [official terms](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php) point buyers toward the brand or country distributor. Start there, and verify a proposed regional seller through the brand’s current site. A search result or social account using the logo is not enough to establish the relationship.

For the US, the [regional terms page](https://usa.elvesbike.com/pages/terms) is another route to check. Compare who issues the invoice, where the order ships from, and where a return would go. Paying in a familiar currency does not answer any of those questions.

Give each seller the same request: exact frame generation, size, finish, cockpit dimensions and delivery destination. Ask which parts are supplied with that package. A complete build pictured beside a frameset listing is inspiration, not an inventory.

sections.heading: Turn your paint idea into an approved specification
paragraphs: Elves’ [terms](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php) describe many frames as made to order and give an ordinary estimate of six to ten weeks for manufacturing and delivery, with seasonal variation. That is a general published estimate, not a dispatch promise for your paint job. Ask the seller for your order’s production completion date and a separate transit estimate.

Approve a written paint specification before work starts. A screen swatch can shift with display settings, so ask what reference the painter will actually use. Also ask when changes or cancellation become unavailable, and whether the chosen finish affects a return.

worksheet.caption: Paint approval — attach to the order
rows: Cockpit width / stem length and seatpost option
Approval date; last date to change or cancel

sections.heading: The same thread contains very different waits
paragraphs: The [Falath Evo thread](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,4032.165.html) includes a 2025 order dispatched after about ten weeks and a different 2026 buyer reporting a little over a month. For a custom frame, use these dates to ask which milestone your seller means by “ready.” They are separate owner reports, not a current brand average.

sections.heading: Your final confirmation should fit on one page
paragraphs: List the exact frame, fork, cockpit, seatpost, headset, axles and small hardware that the seller says are included. Record substitutions only when you have approved them; a different bar width is a fit change, not a harmless packing detail.
Add the delivered price, treatment of import charges, agreed production estimate and warranty contact. Ask how a damaged-on-arrival claim is documented and where replacement parts come from.
Then keep the approved design and order summary together. You want the first unboxing surprise to be how the paint catches the light—not which handlebar was available that week.

zh-Hans.title: Elves 车架购买指南：区域代理、定制涂装与等待时间
zh-Hans.description: Elves 车架如何从官方渠道购买：确认卖家、涂装与把组、生产及运输阶段和退货条款。
zh-Hans.intro: 选颜色是最开心的环节。但在爱上某种涂装之前，先弄清谁接单、买的是哪一代，以及车架什么时候真正能出厂。

sections.heading: 先选卖家，再搭配涂装
paragraphs: [Elves 官方条款](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php)将买家引导至品牌或所在国家代理。先从这里确认渠道，并通过当前官网核对区域卖家。仅凭搜索结果或带标志的社交账号，不能确定授权关系。
美国买家还可查[区域条款页](https://usa.elvesbike.com/pages/terms)。比较发票销售方、发货地点和退货地址。使用熟悉的货币付款，不能回答这些问题。
给不同卖家同一份需求：车架代际、尺码、涂装、把组尺寸及目的地，并问清套餐内含。车架商品旁的整车照片是展示，不是装箱清单。

sections.heading: 把涂装想法变成确认过的规格
paragraphs: [Elves 条款](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php)说明不少车架按单生产，并给出制造加交付通常六至十周的估计，也提醒淡季可能缩短。这是一般说明，不是你的涂装订单的发货承诺。请卖家分别给出生产完成日和运输估计。
生产前批准书面涂装规格。屏幕色块会随显示设置变化，问清喷漆实际使用的参考样。还要问何时不能修改或取消，以及所选涂装是否影响退货。

worksheet.caption: 涂装确认单：与订单一起保存
rows: 把宽／把立长度与座管选项
批准日期；最晚修改或取消日
预计生产完成及发货日期

sections.heading: 同一讨论里，也有完全不同的等待
paragraphs: [Falath Evo 讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,4032.165.html)中，一笔 2025 年订单约十周后发出；另一位 2026 年买家报告一个多月。买定制车架时，可用这些节点追问卖家“准备好”究竟指哪一步。它们是两笔独立经历，不是当前品牌平均交期。

sections.heading: 最后确认应能整理成一页
paragraphs: 列出卖家确认包含的车架、前叉、把组、座管、碗组、桶轴和小零件。只有你同意后才能替换配置；车把宽度变化是合身变化，不是无关紧要的装箱细节。
再加入到手价、进口费用处理、约定生产周期和保修联系人。问到货损坏如何举证，以及更换配件从哪里来。
将确认的设计和订单摘要一起保存。开箱时的惊喜应当是涂装在光线下的效果，而不是那周恰好有货的另一支车把。
